caption:
The bar moved and nobody sent a memo.

A 2026 consumer survey found the share of shoppers who won't consider a business under 4.5 stars jumped from 17% to 31% in a single year.

Nearly half won't look twice at a business with fewer than 20 reviews.

Your work didn't get worse. The competition for attention got stricter, and most shops still ask for reviews only when they remember to.

Fix: request the review within 24 hours of the job, every time, not just from your favorite customers.

DM TRIAL

#ServiceBusiness #OnlineReviews #LocalMarketing #HomeServices #ReputationManagement
rationale: Carousels lead saves for B2B research content, and a fresh 2026 BrightLocal stat on rising star-rating thresholds is unclaimed by any prior review post, tied here to the platform's automated review-request capability.
